violated_contract: A deployment that creates an alert policy from a new Cloud Logging metric must account for Cloud Monitoring's eventual metric visibility. Treating the documented propagation delay as a permanent failure blocks an otherwise valid deployment, while retrying unrelated policy errors or skipping policy verification can hide real alert drift.
canonical_prevention: Retry only the documented metric-not-yet-visible response for the exact newly created metric, re-list the exact policy name before every create attempt to avoid duplicates, and retain the existing post-create policy verifier. Bound the wait to the provider's propagation window and fail all other errors immediately.
